Name: Lithium-Ion Battery Cycling Dataset at 1C, 2C, and 2.75C Discharge Rates
Summary: Run-to-end-of-life cycling records at 1 Hz from three 18650 LFP cells, each discharged at a different C-rate, for state of health and RUL estimation.
Description:
This lithium-ion cycling dataset comes from the EV battery research team of the Manufacturing System Research Group at the Bandung Institute of Technology (ITB), with co-authors from Universitas Langlangbuana and Universitas Pelita Bangsa. Three commercial 18650 cells with LFP chemistry and a nominal 1800 mAh were cycled between April and September 2025 on a battery cycler built at ITB. It was published on Zenodo in 2026.

All cells share the same charge protocol, CC-CV at 1C (1800 mA) up to 100% state of charge, but each one is discharged at constant current to 30% state of charge at its own rate: 2.75C, 2C or 1C. A 5-minute rest separates the steps, the ambient temperature is held at 30 °C, and cycling continues until 70% capacity retention.

Each cell has its own folder of CSV files sampled at 1 Hz with time, charge or discharge mode, voltage, current, capacity and energy. The temperature column contains only zeros. The data is released under CC BY 4.0.
